items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I sat in and played and subbed at Condon’s a couple of times.

ctx.x: That’s pretty interesting that the high school kids would be doing that much dancing. Nowadays it seems like touching each other —

Well that was the end of that era. It was 1956 when I was in college, when Bill Haley came in with “Rock Around the Clock,” and that was really a jitterbug tune, in fact I think Cliff Lehman, Eddie Condon’s drummer, was the drummer on that album.
